CustomField.formula:
IF( Case_Data_Quality_Score__c = 100, "All Case Details Captured",
IF( RIGHT( ( "Missing:" & IF(ISBLANK(AccountId), " Account,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Brand__c)), " Brand,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(ContactId), " Contact,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Contract__c), " Contract,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Country__c)), " Country,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(OwnerId), " Owner,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Status_Reason__c)), " Status Reason,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Subject), " Subject,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(SuppliedEmail), " Email,", "") ), 1 ) = ",",
LEFT( ( "Missing:" & IF(ISBLANK(AccountId), " Account,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Brand__c)), " Brand,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(ContactId), " Contact,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Contract__c), " Contract,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Country__c)), " Country,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(OwnerId), " Owner,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Status_Reason__c)), " Status Reason,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Subject), " Subject,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(SuppliedEmail), " Email,", "") ), LEN( ( "Missing:" & IF(ISBLANK(AccountId), " Account,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Brand__c)), " Brand,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(ContactId), " Contact,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Contract__c), " Contract,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Country__c)), " Country,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(OwnerId), " Owner,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Status_Reason__c)), " Status Reason,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Subject), " Subject,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(SuppliedEmail), " Email,", "") ) ) - 1 ),
/* Else return as-is */ "Missing:" & IF(ISBLANK(AccountId), " Account,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Brand__c)), " Brand,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(ContactId), " Contact,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Contract__c), " Contract,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Country__c)), " Country,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(OwnerId), " Owner,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Status_Reason__c)), " Status Reason,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Subject), " Subject,", "") & IF(ISBLANK(SuppliedEmail), " Email,", "") ) )
CustomField.label: Data Quality Description
